protocol_differences: Selective authenticated direct TRAIN/raw/VALID loader replaces native OGB split/cache loader; TEST file, constructor, graph, queries and scores are absent. The constructed Data has consumed x/id/edge_index/edge_weight attributes; unused OGB processed attributes are absent. Native Collab float32 weight casting before TRAIN/VALID construction is retained.
Native TRAIN/VALID constructors, year>=2007 filter, seed reset plus real get_feature_dim query sampling are retained.

HF alias resolves to the pinned 570-byte non-weight BertConfig via a narrow local AutoConfig binding; native YAML overrides and scratch model constructor are retained. Native definitions imports temporarily use the owned source directory cwd and its empty marker; repository cwd is restored before data/model work.
One torchrun NCCL/DDP rank on authorized GPU0 replaces author launcher default eight automatically selected GPUs; native total accumulation8 becomes eight per rank.
One complete epoch0 plus full VALID is the resource workload; official 20-epoch recipe remains bound and is not a released scientific fit.

Native train_loop/evaluate_loop/build_loaders/get_model implementations are imported byte-identically; native progress text is silenced because it contains training loss; wandb_run=None, evaluator=None.

VALID native helper still constructs per-batch BCE because it receives labels; compute_loss=False prevents aggregation/reporting, evaluator=None prevents predictive metrics; outputs are shape/finite-checked then discarded.
No engineering checkpoint is written; model/optimizer tensors are discarded after resource observation and cannot donate to a scientific fit.
Contemporary admitted Torch2.7.1/PyG2.4.0/NumPy1.26.4 and observed ancillary versions replace author requirements Torch2.5.1/PyG2.6.1/NumPy2.2.6; no numerical parity is claimed.
Native PENCIL bf16 autocast and TF32=True/matmul medium are retained and deliberately differ from the prior NCNC float32/TF32=False numerical profile.

Inherited ownership supervisor includes torchrun/DDP/data-loader descendants in sampled session RSS; two OMP/MKL threads and .25s allocator checks plus finite/shape/custody instrumentation are charged.
